decisions.reason: The bleaching tray blanks had their own dedicated web page in two consecutive years, which shows visible commitment, and they fit the firm's core thermoforming materials line, so management is likely to keep them even if sales are modest.
The PETG thermoforming blank is central to the firm's dental thermoforming direction and was prominently presented on its own page, so sunk investment and public commitment favor keeping it.

The UV-curing lacquer was only mentioned on the website and is less central, but it complements the firm's lab material offering and costs little to maintain, so any weak results can still be blamed on temporary market conditions.

The firm already withdrew the related custom earmold line, which makes this hearing protection product more vulnerable, but it was still listed in 2019 and the earlier decision to enter the audiology segment calls for justification, so management likely persists for now.
